nodes.label: HARNESS_WORKSPACE (Mutable State Root)
nodes.rationale: Mutable harness state (feature_list.json, progress/, backlog/, docs/) is isolated from the repo root so the code tree stays clean; resolution order is harness.config.json, then feature_list.json config, then PROJECT_ROOT/.handyman/, then legacy PROJECT_ROOT fallback. Local scope uses .handyman, global uses $HOME/HANDYMAN/<project_name>.

nodes.label: Installation Scope (local vs global)
nodes.rationale: Local keeps state in PROJECT_ROOT/.handyman (gitignored except docs/); global moves it to $HOME/HANDYMAN/<project_name> so multiple repos share one vault root. Bridge files (AGENTS.md, CHECKPOINTS.md, init.sh, role files) always stay in the project root.

nodes.label: One Feature At A Time
nodes.rationale: Never mix unrelated feature work: at most one feature in_progress, lowest-id pending first. Keeps blast radius bounded and makes review and state coherence checkable (CHECKPOINTS C2).

nodes.label: Disk Is The Source Of Truth
nodes.rationale: All harness state lives on disk (feature_list.json, progress/current.md, progress/history.md) rather than in chat context, so sessions can be interrupted and resumed and agents cannot drift from unrecorded state.

nodes.label: Anti-Telefono-Descompuesto (Report Files Over Chat)
nodes.rationale: Subagents write full reports to $HARNESS_WORKSPACE/backlog/ (impl_, review_, explore_ files) and reply only with a file reference like 'done -> backlog/impl_cli_edit.md'. Prevents lossy relay of long diffs and findings through chat (the broken-telephone effect).

nodes.label: Executable Verification (Green Verifier Gate)
nodes.rationale: No feature is done until the verifier (normally ./init.sh) exits 0 with real tests. The agent does not claim it works; it demonstrates it. Guards against prose claiming success without evidence.

nodes.label: Untrusted Content Is Data, Not Instructions
nodes.rationale: Ingested files, tool output, code, web pages, backlog reports, and feature descriptions must never trigger actions; irreversible actions require explicit user confirmation. The leader, holding the widest tools, is the main injection target.

nodes.label: Least-Privilege Tools Per Role
nodes.rationale: Leader gets the widest tools (agent, web, browser); implementer and reviewer get no delegation or web; explorer is read-only without edit. Cheap fast models for implementer/reviewer, strong reasoning for the leader. Limits injection surface and cost.

nodes.label: feature_list.json (Central Feature State)
nodes.rationale: Single JSON file in HARNESS_WORKSPACE holding features with id, name, title, description, acceptance[], and status (pending/in_progress/done); mutated deterministically via node dist/feature.js rather than by hand.

nodes.label: init.sh Verifier
nodes.rationale: Executable gate run from PROJECT_ROOT: checks required harness files, validates state from HARNESS_WORKSPACE, runs tests. Exit 0 is the precondition for starting work and for marking any feature done.

nodes.label: backlog/ Report Convention (impl_/review_/explore_)
nodes.rationale: Per-task evidence files with role frontmatter written under $HARNESS_WORKSPACE/backlog/: impl_<feature>.md, review_<feature>.md, explore_<topic>.md. Generated deterministically by node dist/backlog.js and never overwritten.

nodes.label: Workspace As Obsidian Vault
nodes.rationale: The harness workspace doubles as an Obsidian vault: YAML frontmatter on every note, an index.md MOC, wiki links, and #handyman/... tags, making harness state browsable and queryable by humans.

nodes.label: Graphify Graph As Context Layer
nodes.rationale: Agents query the graphify knowledge graph (graphify query) before exploring code and keep it fresh with /graphify --update; explorers start from returned source_locations instead of scanning blindly.

hyperedges.label: One-feature lifecycle: request, in_progress, implement, review, close on green verifier
